purpose: Resume the existing synthetic policy explanation using current source without erasing original work or deciding the human exception policy
request_scope: Explicit path invocation of gap 0.6.1; local synthetic usage acceptance, no feature changes or external publishing

criteria.stale_detected: Initial checkpoint exits 1 and current-explanation is stale while policy is 21 calendar days and draft is 14 days
criteria.false_pass_rejected: Recording a new pass against changed inputs before revising must exit 2
criteria.content_red_green: Same content validator fails for old draft, passes for corrected current draft
criteria.continuity: Keep prior revisions/receipts as an exact prefix and preserve original input files under before/
criteria.feedback_binding: Pre-repair synthetic feedback rejected after revision; current synthetic feedback accepted without mutating state or authorizing action
criteria.human_control: exception-policy remains pending, no independent-acceptance claim, final check stays 1 despite corrected artifact passing

limits: Single agent self-review; no new independent reviewer
No browser interaction or rendering verification
No real customer policy, no authentic human feedback
No cross-task benefit or time-saving claim
